summary: During an ordinary trip, someone introduces themselves as a member of the local party committee.
realLife: George Dunne recalled arranging plants in a Chicago church when a visitor brought him a message from the ward committeeman. The ward needed someone to serve as precinct captain, and Dunne agreed to take the job.
inGame: needs: a chance encounter tied to the party worker’s actual committee role.
gates: The player is out alone and the other person belongs to the committee.

turns.what: The party worker recognizes the member but leaves only a name before catching the bus.
turns.pulledBy: The bus arrives during the introduction.
turns.writesBack: The member knows whom they met without agreeing to a meeting.

turns.what: At the next ward meeting, the florist recognizes the messenger and asks which blocks the vacant precinct covers.
turns.pulledBy: The resident has the meeting address from their first conversation and the post is still vacant.
turns.writesBack: The secretary gives the resident a precinct map and records their interest.
